description: Walk-up coin lockers in Japan: size, price, IC card, hours, gate side, and live empties where published.

params.name: service_type

tools.name: source_locker
tools.description: Raw coinlocker-navi locker detail page (HTML). Required: id. Returns the Page.

tools.name: source_search

novel_features.name: Live join on nearest lockers
novel_features.description: See walk-up lockers near a station with live per-size empties attached where Multi Ekicube (nearest bank within 30 m, reservable counts) or the Maihama map publishes them; other lockers have no live field.

novel_features.name: Hours-window filter
novel_features.description: Keep only lockers open across your drop and pick-up times; unknown hours stay visible and flagged.

novel_features.name: Gate side across both sources
novel_features.description: Filter lockers by inside or outside the ticket gates using Multi Ekicube data (exactly one bank within 15 m); unknown gate side never matches, so areas without Multi Ekicube banks return no matches.
